column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule overrides (TASK-090). Format: <rule id><TAB><IGNORE|WARN|FAIL><TAB>(name and reason)
# Every rule not listed keeps ZAP's default (WARN), and the DAST workflow fails on any WARN: a NEW finding
# breaks the job. Each IGNORE is an accepted finding; the reasons are in docs/security/security-audit-2026-11.md.

column3: (ZAP is Out of Date: the image is pinned on purpose; bumped by hand, not mid-scan)
(Suspicious Comments: matches the word "select" inside the minified React bundle; no source comments ship)
(Modern Web Application: informational; the SPA is expected)
(Re-examine Cache-control: index.html is no-cache on purpose so a deploy is picked up; it holds no personal data)
